title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 052
review_goal: Differentiate euro, lira, and naira variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Standalone euro currency sign with two horizontal crossbars across the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the euro symbol by itself with no surrounding ring.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the ring euro sign when the symbol should stay inside a circle.
